summary: FD_TC_068_No Travel Incomplete, Uncontrollable (arrival delay code 85, mandatory security), APPR
title: No Travel Incomplete, Uncontrollable (arrival delay code 85, mandatory security), APPR
description:
Two-leg journey. Leg 1 operated on time. Leg 2 was delayed more than 3 hours by delay code 85. In this scenario, authorities required enhanced security screening of the aircraft and passengers at YYZ (uncontrollable, security). The customer was stranded at the connection (YYZ), chose not to continue, and didn't return to YUL. Checks that No Travel Incomplete plus an uncontrollable security arrival delay code returns Not Eligible under APPR, with a pro-rated or full refund of the unused portion.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC056: one adult passenger, two AC domestic legs YUL?YYZ?YVR, May 29, 2026. Leg 1 AC 466 YUL?YYZ: operated, on time, no delay codes. Leg 2 AC 467 YYZ?YVR: scheduled 11:00 ? 13:05 (local). Actual departure 14:40 (220 min late). Actual arrival 16:50 (225 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 85 (AS). First departure delay code 85 (AS). Customer action: stranded at YYZ (midpoint). Didn't board Leg 2, so the Leg 2 coupon wasn't flown. Didn't return to YUL. Didn't reach YVR. No Travel status: Incomplete. No rebooking accepted.
